# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, recent environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package installations
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies for building LAMMPS and running it
# Includes build tools, Git, OpenMPI for parallel execution, ca-certificates,
# libgomp1 for OpenMP support, and python3 which is a build-time dependency for LAMMPS CMake.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    git \
    gfortran \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 \
    ca-certificates \
    python3 \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# - Allow oversubscribing resources, common in K8s.
# - Use TCP for communication, disabling InfiniBand which is typically not available.
# - Set a specific BTL (Byte Transfer Layer) to avoid issues in some container runtimes.
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_mapping_policy=oversubscribe
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self,vader
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1

# Define the working directory for the application examples
WORKDIR /app

# Build LAMMPS from source
# This single RUN command clones, configures, builds, and installs LAMMPS,
# then copies the example files and cleans up to reduce layer size.
RUN set -e; \
    # Create a temporary directory for the build process
    BUILD_DIR=$(mktemp -d); \
    cd "${BUILD_DIR}"; \
    \
    # Clone the latest stable branch of the LAMMPS repository
    git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git; \
    cd lammps; \
    \
    # Create a build directory and configure the build with CMake
    # We enable the REAXFF package for ReaxFF potential and OpenMP for shared-memory parallelism
    mkdir build && cd build; \
    cmake ../cmake \
          -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
          -D BUILD_OMP=on \
          -D PKG_REAXFF=on; \
    \
    # Compile LAMMPS using all available processor cores
    make -j$(nproc); \
    \
    # Copy the main LAMMPS executable to a system-wide location to be on the PATH
    cp lmp /usr/local/bin/lmp; \
    \
    # Copy the specific example files requested into the final WORKDIR
    cp "${BUILD_DIR}/lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/"* /app/; \
    \
    # Clean up the build directory to keep the final image smaller
    cd /; \
    rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR}";

# Set the entrypoint to the LAMMPS executable.
# Users can override this with commands like `mpirun -np 4 lmp -in in.hns`
ENTRYPOINT ["lmp"]

# Default command, prints LAMMPS help info if no other command is provided
CMD ["-h"]

# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to run a LAMMPS ReaxFF simulation
# using the Flux Framework Operator on a Kubernetes cluster.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reaxff-hns-cpu
  # The job will be created in the 'default' namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI tasks to run. The Flux Operator will prepend
  # `flux run -n 4` to the command provided in the container spec.
  tasks: 4

  # Main application container definition.
  containers:
    - image: "ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax"
      
      # The command to execute the LAMMPS simulation.
      # This command is automatically wrapped by `flux run` by the operator.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite

      # This container is a worker and part of the Flux job allocation, not a
      # dedicated pod for launching the job.
      launcher: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation and logging.
    strict: true
  
  # Do not delete the pods after the job is complete, allowing for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

# Corrected MiniCluster manifest to ensure proper scheduling on ARM architecture.
# The previous version failed due to an incorrect manifest structure and a missing specification for the ARM architecture.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: lammps-reaxff-hns-cpu
  namespace: default
spec:
  # Run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run.
  tasks: 64
  # Do not delete pods upon completion for debugging purposes.
  cleanup: false

  # Flux-specific settings for the broker and workers.
  flux:
    # Specify the target architecture.
    arch: arm
    # FIX: Explicitly set the Flux container image for ARM architecture.
    # This was missing and caused architecture mismatch errors.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Main application container definition.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      command: lmp -v x 4 -v y 4 -v z 4 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      # This container is a worker, not a dedicated job launcher.
      launcher: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation.
    strict: true

  # Pod specification for the MiniCluster nodes.
  pod:
    # FIX: Pod configurations like 'nodeSelector' must be nested under a 'spec' block.
    # The previous placement at 'spec.pod.nodeSelector' was incorrect.
    spec:
      # This nodeSelector ensures the job runs on the specified ARM instance type.
      nodeSelector:
        node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: hpc7g.16xlarge

# Corrects the MiniCluster spec by placing nodeSelector directly under spec.pod
# and adds the required backoffLimit and restartPolicy.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: lammps-reaxff-hns-cpu
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run.
  tasks: 64

  # Do not delete pods upon completion for debugging purposes.
  cleanup: false
  
  # Add backoffLimit as required to limit retries on failure.
  backoffLimit: 1

  # Flux-specific settings for the broker and workers.
  flux:
    # Specify the target architecture for ARM instances.
    arch: arm
    # Explicitly set the Flux container image for ARM architecture.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Main application container definition.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      command: lmp -v x 4 -v y 4 -v z 4 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      # This container is a worker, not a dedicated job launcher.
      launcher: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Pod specification for the MiniCluster nodes.
  pod:
    # FIX: The nodeSelector should be directly under spec.pod, not spec.pod.spec.
    # This was corrected to fix a "strict decoding error".
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: hpc7g.16xlarge
    # Add restartPolicy as required to prevent pods from restarting on failure.
    restartPolicy: "Never"
